notes.title: WE MADE IT!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/yWBdmeo.png

WE MADE IT!

We managed to fund the game in 10 days! And there're 20 other days ahead!

We're trying to make Plus Ultra: Legado reach as many people as possible. 

Thus, we don't want to get stucked at 100%. In fact, we already achieved 105% of the original pledge! We'd like to surpass any limit—Actually, that's the game's motto, PLUS ULTRA. 

Therefore, we're moving forward. Thank you very much to all of you who made this dream come true.

https://i.imgur.com/ObdrkDF.gif

Exclusive rewards!

The following rewards are available EXCLUSIVELY on Kickstarter UNTIL June 15th.
